title: Account assignment
description: access/identity-center/account-assignments/<account-name>/<group-key>--<permission-set-key>.yml - exactly one group-to-permission-set grant in one account (configuration contract; T10 #15 d1-d3). Exact field set, no additional properties. Only the two-segment GROUP form is recognized; no USER representation is defined or reserved (T10 #15 d2). Three-way path/content agreement (directory = account; filename segment 1 = principal.group; segment 2 = permission_set) is enforced by the validator (ASN-AGREEMENT).

account.description: The stable inventory alias - the exact same alias as the directory segment; one path segment in the T15/T05 alias grammar; occurs exactly once in the consumed inventory (T10 #15 d1).

group.description: A T05-valid workforce-group key; assignments reference only key (T05 #7 d2).
